name: Timelost Power gives Discordance three more chain targets (#3691)
contract: Timelost Power 807754's tooltip reads "Your Discordance now strikes $s1 additional enemies." In Spell.dbc it is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS), EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3, EffectSpellClassMask [33554432,0,0], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects Discordance (503875-503880, 582758-582760) and nothing else. Discordance 503875's Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with EffectImplicitTargetA 6 (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY) and EffectChainTarget 4, and its own text is "Blast an enemy and up to ${$x1-1} nearby enemies", i.e. four targets today. Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets reads Effects[effIndex].ChainTarget and applies SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to it before SearchChainTargets (Spell.cpp), so four becomes seven: three additional enemies. Discordance's AttributesEx3 is 0, so SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS does not exempt it. Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Discordance's authored chain of four before the talent
Untalented, the chain count stays at four
The chain count rises to seven
That is exactly three additional enemies
The mask is not over-broad: Chromatic Shard keeps its single target
